semantics.name: Account status
semantics.definition: An active, closed or inactive account is identified by joining accounts.account_status_id to account_statuses.account_status_id and matching status_name exactly to Active, Closed or Inactive.

semantics.name: Active loan
semantics.definition: An active loan is identified by joining loans.loan_status_id to loan_statuses.loan_status_id and matching status_name exactly to Active.

semantics.name: Transaction count
semantics.definition: Transaction count means the number of qualifying rows in banking.transactions.

semantics.name: Transaction amount
semantics.definition: transactions.amount is a positive source magnitude. Do not make it negative based on transaction type. Direction is represented by account_origin_id and account_destination_id.

semantics.name: Transaction volume
semantics.definition: No single transaction-volume metric is approved. A question using transaction volume without defining count or summed amount is ambiguous.

semantics.name: Account balance
semantics.definition: accounts.balance is the recorded account balance. Negative balances are valid and must not be excluded unless the question requests it.

semantics.name: Loan interest rate
semantics.definition: loans.interest_rate stores a fraction between 0 and 1. Multiply by 100 only when presenting a percentage.

semantics.name: Source chronology
semantics.definition: Recorded cross-table dates may be chronologically inconsistent. Do not silently discard rows because an account, loan or transaction date appears out of order.

semantics.name: Same-account transactions
semantics.definition: A transaction may have the same origin and destination account. Do not silently discard these rows.

semantics.name: Fraud data
semantics.definition: The approved banking schema contains no fraud flag, fraud score or fraud outcome. Questions requiring fraud information are unanswerable.
